summary: BioVie Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $6,464,341 of Class A common stock through sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, which receives a fixed 3.0% commission. Shares may be sold on Nasdaq at prevailing prices under Rule 415(a)(4); the last reported sale price was $2.07 on September 8, 2026. As of August 31, 2026, non-affiliates held 8,505,712 shares worth roughly $19.4 million, so the one-third Form S-3 I.B.6 cap limits near-term issuance. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any accelerated selling pressure.
